file.comment_SOD: Source-to-Origin Distance (isocenter). For 200x200x150 volume, SOD=100 gives 201x201x201 padded volume
file.comment_SDD: Source-to-Detector Distance. Typical ratio SDD/SOD ~ 2.0 for cone-beam CT
file.comment_dimensions: h, w, d are the actual reconstruction volume dimensions. Based on paper: 200x200x150 voxels

train.comment_batch_size: May need to reduce batch_size for 3D due to memory constraints. Paper mentions ~10GB for 200x200x150

encoding.comment: Hash grid encoding handles 3D automatically. May need to increase n_levels or n_features_per_level for better 3D capacity

network.comment_capacity: For 3D, may want to increase n_neurons (e.g., 256) or n_hidden_layers (e.g., 3-4) for better representation capacity

memory_reduction: Process volume in sub-regions for very large volumes
capacity_increase: Increase n_levels in hash grid to 20-24

typical_cbct_parameters.SOD: Typically 300-600mm for medical CBCT, 50-150mm for micro-CT
typical_cbct_parameters.SDD: Typically 500-1200mm for medical CBCT, SDD/SOD ratio usually 1.5-2.5
typical_cbct_parameters.detector_size: Flat panel: 20-40cm for medical, 5-10cm for micro-CT
